end.summary:
Recognised some equal-part shapes and named one-fourth, two-fourths and three-quarters.
Practised identifying halves, thirds and quarters; this is partly checked and needs more steady checking next time.
Practised finding a fraction of a collection: found five from five laddoos and two bananas as 1/3 of 12.
Said a third meant one part compared with the parts left on three occasions; this was not corrected by the last seen turn.
end.parentNote: Asha practised equal shares, fraction names, and finding a fraction of a collection with Nisha. Nisha used equal-sized pieces to choose some shapes and answered the straightforward collection questions; they mixed up the whole with the parts left when naming one-third, and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, use 6–12 small objects and ask, “What is one part out of the whole?” before asking how many objects are in that fraction.
